name: pr-commit-helper
description: GitHub Action that reviews pull requests with an LLM (Anthropic, OpenAI-compatible, Gemini) and posts findings as review comments.

scripts.build: esbuild src/index.ts --bundle --platform=node --target=node20 --format=esm --outfile=dist/index.js --legal-comments=external --banner:js="import { createRequire as __cr } from 'module'; const require = __cr(import.meta.url);"
scripts.all: npm run typecheck && npm test && npm run build
